replies.text: {"verdicts":[{"id":"T1","keep":true,"reason":"Design states multi-gigabyte files; resource exhaustion of SFTP volume and parser is concrete."},{"id":"T2","keep":true,"reason":"Parser imports CSV contents directly; partner forging partner id/prices is a concrete tampering attack."},{"id":"T3","keep":true,"reason":"Injection via untrusted CSV fields into database is a distinct attack from row-level forgery."},{"id":"T4","keep":true,"reason":"SFTP upload path exists with no authentication model; credential guessing/spoofed partner upload concrete."},{"id":"T5","keep":true,"reason":"Large files plus unsignalled pickup yields truncated/duplicate imports; distinct from other threats."},{"id":"T6","keep":true,"reason":"Shared SFTP server without isolation lets partners read/overwrite peers' order files."},{"id":"T7","keep":true,"reason":"Design names import action; missing provenance linking orders to partner upload is specific."}]}
